review.assessment: The change replaces `solution.ts` with a shallow copy implementation that relies on array `map` and object spread, leaving all nested structures shared with the original value instead of deep-cloned. This directly violates the task requirement to clone recursively and can be reproduced by modifying any cloned nested property to observe unintended mutations in the original.

findings.actual: `o.n.v` becomes `2` because `{ ...(value as object) }` only copies references for nested values, failing to create independent sub-objects.
findings.call: const o = { n: { v: 1 } }; const c = deepClone(o); c.n.v = 2;
findings.defect: Fails to perform deep cloning (shallow copy only)
